# Deen Akrivos

> Deen Akrivos is a Master's (MASc) researcher in Mechanical Engineering at Concordia University's Turbulence Research Lab (CTRL), working at the intersection of high-fidelity CFD and machine learning. Current research covers hydrogen combustion (jets in crossflow) for low-carbon propulsion and power generation, and reinforcement-learning-based turbulence closure modelling.

He also founded [Vortic CFD](https://vortic.ca), an applied CFD/AI consultancy, and previously worked airside at Montreal-Trudeau airport and at CAE on aircraft simulator software.

## Research

- [Jet spacing effects on flame structure and CVP interaction in reacting hydrogen jets in crossflow](https://dakrivo.com/projects/): high-fidelity LES study (Concordia University) of dual reacting hydrogen jets in crossflow, in preparation for peer-reviewed publication.
- [A velocity-feedback framework for deep reinforcement learning-augmented turbulence modelling](https://dakrivo.com/projects/): a reinforcement-learning framework correcting RANS turbulence closures against DNS/LES data, coupling OpenFOAM, PyTorch, and LibTorch.
